note: Cuplikan pemakaian tiap composable, untuk thumbnail kode di kartu halaman kategori Hooks. Satu sampai tiga baris yang menunjukkan bentuk pemanggilannya — bukan contoh lengkap; itu tugas demo di halamannya. Halaman tanpa berkas (padanan Vue, paket luar) menampilkan cara yang dianjurkan halamannya. Disorot saat build oleh scripts/generate-hook-snippets.mjs.

snippets.use-boolean: const { value, setTrue, setFalse, toggle } = useBoolean(false)
snippets.use-counter: const { count, inc, dec, reset } = useCounter(0)
snippets.use-debounce:
const query = ref('')
const debounced = useDebounce(query, 300)
snippets.use-reset-state: const { state, set, reset } = useResetState({ name: '' })
snippets.use-throttle:
const scrollY = ref(0)
const throttled = useThrottle(scrollY, 200)
snippets.use-creation:
// Cukup konstanta di luar setup
const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID')
snippets.use-memoized-fn:
// Fungsi di setup sudah stabil
const send = () => { /* … */ }
snippets.use-previous:
const count = ref(0)
const previous = usePrevious(count)
snippets.use-debounce-effect:
const { run } = useDebounceFn(() => search(query.value), 300)
watch(query, run)
snippets.use-throttle-effect:
const { run } = useThrottleFn(() => persist(scroll.value), 200)
watch(scroll, run)
snippets.use-update:
const count = ref(0)
count.value += 1 // tampilan ikut
snippets.use-click-away:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
useClickAway(() => close(), el)
snippets.use-clipboard:
const { copy, copied } = useClipboard()
await copy('hello')
snippets.use-element-size:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
const { width, height } = useElementSize(el)
snippets.use-fullscreen:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
const { isFullscreen, toggle } = useFullscreen(el)
snippets.use-hover:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
const isHovered = useHover(el)
snippets.use-in-viewport:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
const { inViewport, ratio } = useInViewport(el)
snippets.use-stick-to-bottom:
const el = ref<HTMLElement>()
const { isAtBottom, scrollToBottom } = useStickToBottom(el)
